1.explanation:
• CopyPaste.js and Paste.js implement the copy/paste pipeline and are responsible for serializing and deserializing element data, including labels.  
• LabelUtil.js contains helpers to read/write label properties on BPMN shapes.  
• LabelEditing.js hooks into modeling to create and render labels in the diagram.  
• BpmnImporter.js handles the import of pasted elements into the model, where missing label data would be dropped.  
• LabelPasteSpec.js (the failing test) reproduces the scenario and shows how labels are lost, guiding you to pinpoint the failure in the copy/paste or import steps.
1.bug_scenario: The user selects a pool (participant) containing a start event labeled “A”, a task box and an end event labeled “B”. They copy the entire participant contents, clear the diagram and then paste. The shapes reappear, but both text labels (“A” and “B”) are missing after the paste.
